summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, returning True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md adds an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions, so verification is by reading only. Nothing is committed.
